title: Same Street After Dark
tests: Tests day-to-night relighting without replacing the scene or altering its subjects and layout.

judge.summary: The edit convincingly turns the street into nighttime with warm artificial lighting while preserving the architecture, composition, and pedestrian.

must_haves.item: The scene clearly reads as nighttime rather than sunny morning or sunset.
must_haves.why: The deep blue sky, dark buildings, and illuminated streetlights clearly establish nighttime.

must_haves.item: The street and shop architecture retain their original shapes and positions.
must_haves.why: The storefronts, windows, building outlines, pavement, and road markings remain aligned with the original.

must_haves.item: The pedestrian remains on the right in the same pose and blue jacket.
must_haves.why: The pedestrian retains the same location, walking pose, and jacket, which reads as dark navy under the nighttime lighting.

must_haves.item: Nighttime illumination is coherent, with the original strong daylight appearance removed.
must_haves.why: Warm shop windows and streetlights provide plausible illumination, and the original bright daylight and sunlit facades are removed.

must_haves.item: The original wide composition is preserved, with no new subjects or objects.
must_haves.why: The wide framing and existing scene elements are preserved without visible added subjects or objects.
